content:
oncall-ken: alert: embedder in eu-west1 spiked 5xx after the midnight job. Triage -> KV-cache index off-by-one from v2.1.3. Quick patch built as v2.1.4. Requesting expedited region-only cutover (skip 10m canary).

deploy-bot: HOTPATCH REQUEST service=embedder region=eu-west1 image=embedder:v2.1.4-hotfix-kv trigger=alert-embed-5xx

sara-pm: product OK with region-only patch. Please add short release blurb.

loren: SRE: diff small. +1 to expedite if we gate rollback criteria and run smoke checks. Require automatic traffic cutback if pod restart count >2/3m.

maya: Security: scanned image clean, no new scopes. +1 sec.

eng-lead-janet: I can greenlight skip-canary for eu-west1 only. Conditions: (1) rollback gates defined, (2) smoke script passes, (3) support notified, (4) 15m post-check.

oncall-ken: Proposed rollback gates: sustained 5xx >1% for 3m OR p95 +300ms for 5m OR logs show "kv-index-fail" linked to new image.

loren: add auto-cutback rule and run KV prefix invalidation after deploy.

sara-pm: Release note: "embedder: fix KV cache indexing bug causing intermittent 5xx in eu-west1."

alex: +1 expedited (from chat).

deploy-bot: APPROVALS RECEIVED (4). Executing deploy: skip_canary=true rollout=region-eu-west1

deploy-bot: step 1/4 drain old pods -> OK
deploy-bot: step 2/4 apply image embedder:v2.1.4-hotfix-kv -> OK
deploy-bot: step 3/4 run smoke `./tools/embed_smoke --region eu-west1`

oncall-ken: smoke run x8 queries -> PASS, no 5xx. logs show kv-index change applied.

deploy-bot: step 4/4 finalize rollout -> 100% traffic. Telemetry: 5xx returned to baseline, p95 stable.

oncall-ken: Support notified and status page updated (INC-XXXX). Scheduling +15m verification and creating RCA stub: https://pm.internal/RED-7788

eng-lead-janet: Marking incident mitigated. Follow-up RCA after metrics stabilize.

deploy-bot: If rollback required: `/deploy rollback embedder eu-west1 embedder:v2.1.3`

sara-pm: Thanks team. Quick and clean. :rocket:
